description: Find customer domains with observed technology transition signals involving a specified vendor and return prioritized signals with supporting evidence. USE WHEN: an agent needs to identify customer-level technology transition signals related to a vendor for prospecting or change analysis. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs confirmed proof that a customer switched from one vendor to another; POSSIBLE_REPLACEMENT is a correlated signal, not a confirmed switch. Parameter semantics: vendor identifies the vendor whose customer transition signals should be evaluated. Returns prioritized customer-domain signals with observed state, relevant timestamps, evidence, and applicable limitations.

vendor.description: Vendor whose customer technology transition signals should be evaluated.
